Title: Windows Service Operations Current State
Content: MemorySmith.App supports operational command-line flags for installing and uninstalling itself as a Windows Service. Use --install-service or --uninstall-service before normal host startup. Install options include --service-name, --service-display-name, --service-description, and --service-start-type. Arguments after -- are preserved as runtime arguments for the service process, such as --urls http://localhost:5089. The app also calls UseWindowsService so the same executable can run under the Windows Service Control Manager. These flags are deployment operations, not memory record fields.
